items.claim: Denis Buzukja lacks durability and has been hurt and knocked out multiple times.
items.quote: Buzukja who's, you know, been hurt quite a few times, who's been knocked out quite a few times.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad has more volume, is dangerous everywhere, and is a BJJ black belt.
items.quote: he's going to throw a lot of volume. I think he's much more dangerous wherever the fight goes. He's a BJJ black belt.

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev has questionable age and is potentially closer to 40 than 36.
items.quote: this guy says he's 36 years old. He's probably like closer to 40.

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev has declining cardio and a durability that is waning.
items.quote: I don't think he has the best cardio. I think his durability is waning a bit.

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev is deficient in his ground grappling.
items.quote: this guy's a a wipeout on the mat.

items.claim: Ludovit Klein is younger and superior everywhere compared to Musayev.
items.quote: Klein's obviously the younger guy. Klein's going to be better everywhere in my opinion.
